The best Thai cuisines restaurant in D3 HCMC
Apr 2026 • Business
I recently visited TukTuk Thai Bistro on Ngo Thoi Nhiem for a business meal and was thoroughly impressed. The location in District 3 is very convenient, and the restaurant offers a modern, energetic atmosphere that works perfectly for a professional yet casual meeting.
The food was definitely the highlight. Every dish we ordered was vibrant, fresh, and stayed true to authentic Thai flavors. The Pad Thai was perfectly seasoned, and the pomelo salad provided a refreshing balance to the meal.
Service was also excellent—attentive and professional throughout our visit, ensuring everything arrived promptly so we could focus on our conversation. It’s rare to find such a great balance of atmosphere, high-quality food, and efficient service.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable and delicious Thai spot in Ho Chi Minh City!
